questions.question_english: If a Principal decides to multiply every student's test score by 2, what will happen to the variance of the scores?
options_english: It will be multiplied by 2.
It will remain the same.
It will be divided by 2.
It will be multiplied by 4.
questions.explanation_english: Multiplying every score in a distribution by a constant scales the standard deviation by that same constant.
